ei.title: 5번: The Misunderstanding of the Manhattan Deal
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various indigenous tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.

questions.passage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already (A)[occupied / abandoned] by various indigenous tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a (B)[shocking / expected] deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources (C)[belonged / donated] to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) occupied=점유된, (B) shocking=충격적인, (C) belonged=~에 속했다
det.analysis:
❌ ① abandoned — shocking — belonged: (A) abandoned(버려진)는 occupied(점유된)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② occupied — expected — belonged: (B) expected(예상된)는 shocking(충격적인)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ occupied — shocking — donated: (C) donated(기부된)는 belonged(속했다)와 의미 불일치
✅ ④ occupied — shocking — belonged: 원문 일치
det.tip: occupied = 점유된 / shocking = 충격적인 / belonged to = ~에 속했다

questions.passage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch (A)[settlers / invaders] had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various indigenous tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big (B)[misunderstanding / agreement]. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be (C)[shared / divided], but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) settlers=정착민, (B) misunderstanding=오해, (C) shared=공유되다
det.analysis:
❌ ① settlers — agreement — shared: (B) agreement(합의)는 misunderstanding(오해)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② invaders — misunderstanding — shared: (A) invaders(침략자)는 settlers(정착민)와 의미 불일치
✅ ③ settlers — misunderstanding — shared: 원문 일치. 정착민, 오해, 공유
❌ ④ settlers — misunderstanding — divided: (C) divided(분할된)는 shared(공유된)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: settlers = 정착민 / misunderstanding = 오해 / shared = 공유된

questions.passage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various indigenous tribes. According to (A)[legend / rumor], the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, (B)[cultural / personal] differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain (C)[purposes / profits], such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) legend=전설, (B) cultural=문화적인, (C) purposes=목적들
det.analysis:
❌ ① legend — personal — purposes: (B) personal(개인적인)은 cultural(문화적인)과 의미 불일치
❌ ② legend — cultural — profits: (C) profits(이익)는 purposes(목적)와 의미 불일치
✅ ③ legend — cultural — purposes: 원문 일치
❌ ④ rumor — cultural — purposes: (A) rumor(소문)은 legend(전설)와 뉘앙스 불일치
det.tip: legend = 전설 / cultural differences = 문화적 차이 / for certain purposes = 특정 목적을 위해

questions.passage: One of the most amazing ①<u>bargains</u> in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already ②<u>vacated</u> by various indigenous tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the ③<u>entire</u> island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural ④<u>resources</u> belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② vacated: 원문 occupied(점유된)를 vacated(비워진)로 교체 → 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① bargains: 역사상 가장 놀라운 거래(bargains) — 원문 일치 적절
✅ ② vacated: 원문은 occupied(점유된). 원주민들이 이미 살고 있었으므로 vacated(비워진)는 문맥상 반대
❌ ③ entire: 맨해튼 섬 전체(entire island) — 원문 일치 적절
❌ ④ resources: 자연 자원(natural resources) — 원문 일치 적절
det.tip: occupied = 점유된 ↔ vacated = 비운. 원주민이 살고 있었으므로 occupied가 맞음

questions.passage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch ①<u>settlers</u> had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various ②<u>indigenous</u> tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of ③<u>property</u> rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be ④<u>owned</u>, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ owned: 원문 shared(공유된)를 owned(소유된)로 교체 → 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① settlers: 네덜란드 정착민들(Dutch settlers) — 원문 일치 적절
❌ ② indigenous: 토착 부족들(indigenous tribes) — 원문 일치 적절
❌ ③ property: 재산권(property rights) — 원문 일치 적절
✅ ④ owned: 원문은 shared(공유된). Lenape 시각에서 땅은 공유 대상이지 소유 대상이 아님. owned(소유된)는 부적절
det.tip: shared(공유된) ↔ owned(소유된). In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold

questions.passage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various indigenous tribes. According to ②<u>legend</u>, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been ①<u>natural</u>. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were ③<u>agreeing</u> to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing ④<u>crops</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① natural: 원문 strange(이상한)를 natural(자연스러운)로 교체 → 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① natural: 원문은 strange(이상한). 땅을 파는 것이 Lenape에게 이상했다는 문맥에서 natural(자연스러운)은 정반대
❌ ② legend: 전설에 따르면(According to legend) — 원문 일치 적절
❌ ③ agreeing: 동의하고 있다고 생각했다 — 원문 일치 적절
❌ ④ crops: 작물을 재배하는(growing crops) — 원문 일치 적절
det.tip: strange(이상한) ↔ natural(자연스러운). 땅을 파는 것은 Lenape에게 이상한 일

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그 땅은 이미 다양한 원주민 부족들에 의해 '점유되어' 있었다
det.analysis:
❌ ① shared: 공유된 — 뒤에서 Lenape의 관점으로 나올 표현이지 was __ by 수동태와 의미 불일치
✅ ② occupied: 원주민들이 이미 거주하고 있었으므로 occupied(점유된)가 적절
❌ ③ sold: 팔린 — 땅이 원주민에 의해 팔렸다는 의미가 되어 문맥 부적절
❌ ④ shocking: 충격적인 — 형용사로 was __ by 수동태 구조에 부적절
det.tip: occupied by = ~에 의해 점유된. 원주민이 이미 거주하고 있었다는 문맥

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 문화적 차이가 큰 '오해'를 야기했을 것이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① understanding: 이해 — 문화적 차이가 이해를 야기했다는 것은 문맥상 반대
❌ ② disagreement: 의견 불일치 — 의도적 갈등이 아니라 무의식적 오해가 핵심
✅ ③ misunderstanding: 문화적 차이로 인해 재산권에 대한 큰 오해가 발생
❌ ④ communication: 소통 — 문화적 차이가 소통을 야기했다는 것은 부자연스러움
det.tip: cultural differences + property rights → big misunderstanding

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 특정 '목적'을 위해서만 땅을 사용하도록
det.analysis:
❌ ① differences: 차이점 — 앞 문장에서 이미 사용되었고 'for certain differences'는 어색
❌ ② resources: 자원 — 'for certain resources'는 활동 목적이 아닌 물건
❌ ③ items: 물품 — 'for certain items'는 물건이지 활동 목적이 아님
✅ ④ purposes: 동물 기르기나 작물 재배 같은 특정 목적(purposes)
det.tip: for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops

det.analysis:

questions.passage:
(A) One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken <u>place</u> in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. According to legend, they made a shocking deal with the Lenape tribe.
(B) This is a beautiful <u>place</u> to live and raise a family. The neighborhood has good schools and parks. Many people dream of moving here someday.
questions.stem: 다음 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 place의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) take place = 발생하다, 일어나다 / (B) place = 장소, 곳
det.analysis:
❌ ① 장소 — 발생하다: 순서 반전
❌ ② 놓다 — 장소: (A)의 place는 놓다가 아님
❌ ③ 발생하다 — 놓다: (B)의 place는 장소이지 놓다가 아님
✅ ④ 발생하다 — 장소: (A) take place = 발생하다, (B) place = 장소
det.tip: place (1) take place = 발생하다 (2) 명사 = 장소

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a traditional story from the past, often regarded as historical but not verified"

det.korean: 과거로부터 전해 내려오는 검증되지 않은 전통적 이야기 = legend
det.analysis:
❌ ① evidence: 증거 — 검증된 사실로 정의와 반대
✅ ② legend: 전설 — 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ contract: 계약 — 법적 합의
❌ ④ bargain: 거래 — 매매 합의
det.tip: legend = 전설. According to legend = 전설에 따르면

questions.passage: If this legend is true, cultural differences __________ (relate) to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: cultural differences related to = ~에 관련된 문화적 차이. relate → 과거분사 related
det.analysis: relate → 과거분사 related. 'differences related to ~' = ~에 관련된 차이들. 수동 관계로 후치 수식
det.tip: related to = ~에 관련된. 과거분사가 명사를 후치 수식

questions.passage: The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of __________ (sell) their land would have been strange.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: the idea of selling = 파는 것이라는 개념. sell → 동명사 selling
det.analysis: 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 함. sell → selling
det.tip: the idea of + V-ing. 전치사 뒤에는 동명사

questions.passage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various indigenous tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 특정 목적, 예를 들어 '동물을 기르거나 작물을 재배하는' 것
det.analysis:
✅ ① keeping animals or growing crops: 원문 일치. such as 뒤에 나오는 구체적 활동
❌ ② beads and small items: 구슬과 소품 — 지불 수단이지 토지 사용 목적이 아님
❌ ③ wild animals and natural resources: 야생 동물과 자연 자원 — 섬의 특징이지 사용 목적이 아님
❌ ④ the entire island of Manhattan: 맨해튼 섬 전체 — 거래 대상이지 사용 목적이 아님
det.tip: such as keeping animals or growing crops

They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of __________ would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재산권 개념에 관련된 문화적 차이가 오해를 야기
det.analysis:
❌ ① natural resources: 자연 자원 — 오해의 원인이 아님
❌ ② cultural traditions: 너무 포괄적
✅ ③ property rights: 재산권 — 핵심 오해의 원인
❌ ④ trade agreements: 무역 합의 — 거래 자체이지 원인이 아님
det.tip: property rights = 재산권. 토지 소유 개념 차이가 오해의 핵심
